sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the offering of seventy bulls during Sukkos corresponds to the seventy nations, elevating them to their ultimate purpose of serving Israel, and that this is now accomplished through verbal recitation of the relevant verses.

translations.translation: Now, in the continuation
of the mitzvah of dwelling in the sukkah and taking the four species, comes the mitzvah of offering seventy bulls corresponding to the seventy nations,
meaning that through the offering of the seventy bulls, they protect the seventy nations
and reveal the ultimate purpose of their creation,
for the entire world was only created to serve this one,
and I was created to serve my Maker.
For the true essence of them
(of the nations of the world)
is as it will be in the future, to serve Israel, etc.,
and as it is written,
"And kings shall be your nursemaids, and their princesses your wet nurses,"
and certainly those below kings and their princesses.
And since all the matters and revelations of the future depend on our actions and service during the six thousand years
(including the time of exile,
and on the contrary, they depend primarily on the service during the time of exile),
the matter of "and kings shall be your nursemaids, etc." that will be in the future is accomplished through the offering of the seventy bulls during the time of the Temple,
and through "and let us render the bulls of our lips" since the destruction of the Temple, etc., during the time of exile.
For it is known that the service of the offerings
(and likewise the service of "and let us render the bulls of our lips")
affects the entire world,
for through the offering of one animal, an elevation is made in the entire animal species, etc.,
(for through the raising of the blood and fat, which are the vitality and pleasure of the animal being offered, an elevation is made in the entire animal species),
and through the drawing down from above to below that results, a drawing down is made in the entire animal species, etc.
And likewise is it with the offering of the seventy bulls, which correspond to the seventy nations,
that the elevation and drawing down through these offerings affect all seventy nations,
and so too is it with the recitation of the verses, for the movement of one's lips is an action,
that through reciting the verses of the offerings of the seventy bulls that correspond to the seventy nations, a drawing down and subjugation is made in them,
and the purpose of their creation is revealed in them,
that they were only created to serve this one, etc.,
and it is revealed that "You have chosen us from all the nations."
And this is what is written,
"Praise Hashem, all nations; extol Him, all peoples, for His kindness has overwhelmed us," etc.,
for seemingly, what is the connection of "His kindness has overwhelmed us" that because of this the nations and peoples should praise and extol Him?
And the explanation of this is known,
that because His kindness has overwhelmed us, a refinement, purification, and elevation is made also in the nations and peoples,
to the point that this is discernible in them in a revealed way,
and therefore they praise and extol Hashem.
And this matter is accomplished through the offering of the seventy bulls,
and likewise through the service of "and let us render the bulls of our lips,"
for since the movement of one's lips is an action, therefore the effect through our lips is also in the world of Action.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection between the seventy bulls and Sukkos, stating that the encompassing light of the sukkah must first be drawn down to blind the external forces, serving as a preparation for the subsequent internal refinement of the nations through the offerings.

translations.translation: And this is the connection and link of the offering of the seventy bulls to "in sukkot you shall dwell,"
because in order to affect the nations and peoples, there must first be a drawing down of the encompassing light that comes through the sukkah,
for an encompassing light blinds the eyes of the external ones.
And even though the refinement of the nations and peoples is specifically through internal service
[therefore the refinement of the seventy nations is accomplished through the offering of the seventy bulls,
for offerings are a matter of internality,
"My bread for My fire"],
and analogous to the general matter of refinements, which is through internal service, as per the statement,
"Bread on the edge of a sword he eats"
[for eating is a matter of internal refinement],
nevertheless, first there must be a drawing down of the encompassing light of the sukkah,
through which a general nullification and subjugation is made in them,
and this nullification is an introduction, preparation, and qualification for their refinement afterwards through the offering of the seventy bulls,
and likewise through "and let us render the bulls of our lips" during the time of exile,
and it is also an immediate preparation for the offering of the seventy bulls in its literal sense.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that dwelling in the sukkah in a settled manner draws the encompassing light into revealed powers, enabling one to affect the nations and prepare for the future revelation of "every citizen in Israel."

translations.translation: And this is "in sukkot you shall dwell... so that your generations may know, etc."
That through "in sukkot you shall dwell,"
the fact that the encompassing light of the sukkah is in a manner of "you shall dwell,"
and on the contrary,
the entire matter of the mitzvah of sukkah is "you shall dwell"
["you shall dwell" as in "you shall reside,"
that his eating and drinking and all his affairs that he does in his house should be in the sukkah],
this causes that the encompassing lights will be drawn down also into "your generations,"
meaning into the revealed powers
(Chabad and the seven emotive attributes),
and to the point that "your generations may know,"
"know" from the term of connection,
that the effect of the encompassing lights upon the revealed powers is in a manner of knowledge and connection.
And the reason
(and the enabling power)
for this is,
"for in sukkot I caused the children of Israel to dwell when I brought them out of the land of Egypt."
For since I
(the Holy One, blessed be He)
am the initiator,
"in sukkot I caused to dwell,"
this gives power to each and every one of Israel,
"you are called 'man'"
from the term "likeness to the Supernal One,"
that he too will effect an action analogous to the action of the Holy One, blessed be He,
that he will draw down the peace of "the sukkah of Your peace" into all matters of his service and in all his imagery
(until "your generations," his revealed powers, will know),
and to the point that the drawing down of the encompassing light of the sukkah will be felt by him also in his prayer,
including also the Musaf prayer and the recitation of the verses of the offerings of the seventy bulls,
through which he also affects the seventy nations in their literal sense,
and as we say in Hallel
[for on all seven days of Sukkos we recite the complete Hallel]
"Praise Hashem, all nations; extol Him, all peoples,"
which refers to nations and peoples in their literal sense.
And this also serves as an immediate preparation for "every citizen in Israel,"
that he will shine in the future,
"they shall dwell."
For it is known what the Rambam wrote
in his explanation of the World to Come,
that the World to Come is existing and standing
(even now),
and what it is called "the World to Come" is because it comes after
(and subsequent to)
the service in this world.
For so too is it regarding the matters of the future,
that the matters
(are made and)
exist also now,
and what they are called "future to come" is because their drawing down and revelation is after and through the precedence of service in this world.
And this is "in sukkot you shall dwell... every citizen in Israel, etc.,"
that through the fulfillment of the mitzvah of "in sukkot you shall dwell," they draw down even now the aspect of "every citizen in Israel,"
and this serves as an immediate preparation for the revelation of this aspect in the future,
when it will be revealed in all its full force.
